faq.label: Good to know
faq.title:
A few answers.
Before you print.

items.q: Can I print a small quantity?
items.a: Yes. Print & Go offers print-on-demand services. Tell us what you need and we’ll confirm the suitable process and quantity for your product.

items.q: How soon can my order be ready?
items.a: Timing depends on the product, quantity, artwork and finish. Share your deadline when you enquire so our team can confirm what’s possible.

items.q: What if I’m not sure about the specifications?
items.a: Start with the purpose and quantity. Our team can discuss the size, material and finish with you before confirming the job.
We’re at Lot 1.44 & 1.45, Ground Floor, Wisma Central, Jalan Ampang, Kuala Lumpur. Please call ahead to confirm opening hours.

about.label: YOUR LOCAL PRINT PARTNER
about.title: Big on ideas.
about.text: Print & Go Fast Print. Part of everyday business in Kuala Lumpur since 2004.
about.imageAlt: Concept arrangement of printed business stationery
paragraphs: Established in May 2004 by Jay Kok, Print & Go was built around instant printing and print-on-demand services.
From our shop at Wisma Central on Jalan Ampang, we help with the everyday materials that keep businesses moving: name cards, letterheads, envelopes, company profiles, brochures and leaflets.
Whether it’s a small quantity or a larger run, we’re here to work through the format, finish and timing with you.
